map.🎲 随机中文名字（内置姓氏+名）: 🎲 Random Chinese Names (built-in surname and given-name pools)
map.中文姓名按库随机组合：姓名 = 姓氏库随机取 1 字 + 名字库随机取 1 至: A Chinese name is randomly assembled from the pools: name = 1 character drawn at random from the surname pool + 1 to 2 characters drawn at random from the given-name pool; the total number of candidates = number of surnames × number of given names (for single-character names) or number of surnames × the square of the number of given names (for two-character names); the pool can be filtered by gender and constrained by name length, and the collision rate falls as the pools grow.
map.📚 深度解析：随机中文名字（内置姓氏+名）: 📚 Deep Dive: Random Chinese Names (built-in surname and given-name pools)
map.测试数据：给用户表造中文姓名样例，验证展示与排序。: Test data: create sample Chinese names for a user table to check display and sorting.
map.角色起名：写作用时随机取几个候选名再挑选。: Character naming: draw a few candidate names at random while writing and then pick one.
map.脱敏占位：用仿真名替换真实样本中的姓名。: Anonymized placeholders: replace names in real samples with simulated ones.
map.设性别男、2 字，工具输出「陈宇/李铭/王浩」等，可直接填入测试表或草稿。: Set the gender to male and the length to 2 characters; the tool outputs names such as "Chen Yu / Li Ming / Wang Hao", ready to paste into a test sheet or a draft.
map.随机组合而成，可能与真实姓名偶然重合，但非真实身份，请勿冒用。: They are random combinations and may coincidentally match a real name, but they are not real identities and must not be used to impersonate anyone.
map.能选性别字数吗？: Can gender and length be chosen?
map.支持按页面选项设定性别与名字字数；具体以页面为准。: Gender and name length can be set through the page's options; the page is authoritative.
map.本地生成不上传，关闭即不留存，适合含姓名字段的样例。: It is generated locally with no upload and nothing remains after you close the page, which suits samples containing name fields.
